_comment: Every path is TOOL, FIXTURE or DATA under Skill Repo Spec section 9.
TOOL is public code, documentation and metrics about the tool itself.
FIXTURE contains only synthetic examples produced by tools/make_fixtures.py.
DATA is actual run output and research observations in a versioned PRIVATE companion.
The public tool has no in-repository DATA fallback. guards/tools/datadir.py resolves storage.
guards/tools/data_boundary.py enforces declared boundaries in hooks and CI.
_fixture_note: Declared example artifacts are generated by tools/make_fixtures.py. Provider names describe parser contracts; identities, amounts and observations are synthetic.
_audited: Runtime source plans, pull and collection receipts, opportunities, digests, dedup state, roster consumption, source-health reports, completeness reports, wrapper logs and identity sweeps are DATA in the separate PRIVATE companion. Each write target is checked by path only: it must sit in a separate companion worktree outside this source tree, with no subprocess and no visibility proof; PRIVATE publication is enforced at commit time by the Guards hooks and CI. Unversioned and own-tool targets fail closed. Reads may remain uninitialized; writers never invent a fallback.
_armed: Pinned data-boundary checks remain required. The consumer adapter binds only its privately loaded resolver instance to the canonical repository root, including linked worktrees; pinned kit files remain unchanged.
_dependencies: Runtime writes check destinations by path only: a separate companion worktree outside this source tree, with no subprocess and no visibility proof; PRIVATE publication is enforced at commit time by the Guards hooks and CI. The pinned datadir resolver remains the discovery authority. A scoped consumer-root adapter handles its linked-worktree limitation; the shared-kit followup is recorded in private implementation evidence.
_data_home: DAILY_HOTSPOTS_CONFIG or DAILY_HOTSPOTS_DATA_DIR selects the companion through pinned guards. Explicit archive and roster destinations must also sit, by path, in a separate companion worktree outside this source tree; PRIVATE publication is enforced at commit time by the Guards hooks and CI.
